∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {p : ℕ} (k : ℕ)
  (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ),
  ∀ m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k)),
    0 ≤ (BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian k) V).trace - m / R.q k
∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (v : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : Fin n), (∑ j, v j) i = ∑ j, v j i

∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∃ U lam,
      Matrix.transpose U * U = 1 ∧
        U * Matrix.transpose U = 1 ∧ Matrix.transpose U * H * U = Matrix.diagonal lam ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < lam i

∀ {n : ℕ} (b : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec (n + 1)),
  BfgsVerification.dot (Fin.cons 1 b) x = x 0 + BfgsVerification.dot b (Fin.tail x)

∀ {n : ℕ} (A : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (a b : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (κ r : ℝ),
  IsUnit (Matrix.det A) →
    Matrix.IsSymm A →
      κ ≠ 0 →
        κ ^ 2 * Matrix.det (BfgsVerification.CompressionDeterminant.compression A a b κ r) =
          Matrix.det A *
            ((κ - BfgsVerification.dot a (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ b)) ^ 2 +
              BfgsVerification.dot a (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ a) * (r - BfgsVerification.dot b (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ b)))
∀ (J m : ℕ), ¬J + (m + 1) = J + m + 1 → False

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} {K : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)} {fstar c₁ c₂ η : ℝ}
  (W : BfgsVerification.Vec n → BfgsVerification.Mat n) (m C δ : ℝ) (m_pos : 0 < m) (delta_pos : 0 < δ)
  (positive_semidefinite :
    ∀ x ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → Matrix.PosSemidef (W x))
  (visibility :
    ∀ x ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η,
      ∀ (g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
        HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x → m ≤ BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (W x) g)
  (secant :
    ∀ (x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      x ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η →
        z ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η →
          BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h →
            BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.pairDecrease x z g ≤ δ →
              BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (W z) (h - g) ≤
                C * BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.pairCurvature x z g h)
  (W_1 : BfgsVerification.Vec n → BfgsVerification.Mat n) (m_1 C_1 δ_1 : ℝ) (m_pos_1 : 0 < m_1) (delta_pos_1 : 0 < δ_1)
  (positive_semidefinite_1 :
    ∀ x ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → Matrix.PosSemidef (W_1 x))
  (visibility_1 :
    ∀ x ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η,
      ∀ (g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
        HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x → m_1 ≤ BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (W_1 x) g)
  (secant_1 :
    ∀ (x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      x ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η →
        z ∈ BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.positiveBand F K fstar η →
          BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h →
            BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.pairDecrease x z g ≤ δ_1 →
              BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (W_1 z) (h - g) ≤
                C_1 * BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.pairCurvature x z g h),
  ({ W := W, m := m, C := C, δ := δ, m_pos := m_pos, delta_pos := delta_pos,
        positive_semidefinite := positive_semidefinite, visibility := visibility, secant := secant } =
      { W := W_1, m := m_1, C := C_1, δ := δ_1, m_pos := m_pos_1, delta_pos := delta_pos_1,
        positive_semidefinite := positive_semidefinite_1, visibility := visibility_1, secant := secant_1 }) =
    (W = W_1 ∧ m = m_1 ∧ C = C_1 ∧ δ = δ_1)

∀ {n : ℕ} (x y : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.dot x y ^ 2 ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm x * BfgsVerification.sqNorm y

∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (BfgsVerification.Vec n)) (hA : A.Nonempty) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  ∃ a ∈ A, BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.finiteMaxLinear A hA x = BfgsVerification.dot a x

∀ {gap S T : ℕ → ℝ} {E₀ : ℝ},
  (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ gap k) →
    (∀ (N : ℕ), gap N ^ 2 * S N ≤ E₀ + T N) →
      Filter.Tendsto S Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun N => T N / S N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto gap Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

∀ {n : ℕ} {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {q δ : ℕ → ℝ} {K C : ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.NormalizedHierarchy n E q δ K C →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ δ k) →
      Summable δ → Filter.Tendsto (fun N => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (q i)⁻¹) / ↑N ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
